// FAQ, two columns: every question and its answer visible at once, no clicking. Good for short answers. // The heading sits left with a link to the help center on the right; the questions run in two columns on // wider screens and one on phones, as a description list. import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react" const FAQS = [ ["How long does it take to set up?", "About ten minutes. Add your logo and bank details, import your clients from a CSV, and the first invoice is ready to send."], ["Do my clients need an account?", "No. They get an email with a link, see the invoice in their browser and pay in a minute, on any device."], ["How can clients pay?", "By card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank transfer. You choose which methods appear on each invoice."], ["When does the money reach my bank?", "Card payments land in two working days. Bank transfers arrive as soon as your client's bank sends them."], ["Can I bill in other currencies?", "Yes. Studio covers five currencies and Agency thirty. Orbit shows the rate it used on every payment."], ["Does Orbit handle tax?", "Set a tax rate per client or per line, and Orbit adds it and keeps a tax report you can export at the end of the quarter."], ["Can my accountant get access?", "Invite them for free. They can read and export everything but can't send invoices or change your settings."], ["What happens if I leave?", "Export every invoice and payment as CSV and PDF.
